Class MatchDAO

java.lang.Object
database.MatchDAO
public class MatchDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for executing CRUD operations related to match histories. It abstracts the SQL logic away from the main application. Data Access Object (DAO) Pattern

  • Method Details

    • saveMatch

      public void saveMatch(List<ScoreRecord> records)
      Saves a list of match results to the database using batch processing.

      This method opens a dedicated, short-lived connection to ensure thread-safety without complex synchronization blocks. It processes all player records from a single match in one network trip to the database. * @param records A List of ScoreRecord objects containing the data of all players who completed the match.

    • getTopScores

      public List<ScoreRecord> getTopScores(int playerCount, int limit)
      Retrieves the top scoring players for a specific match mode (player count). Queries the database for the highest-scoring matches in a given player count category and returns them sorted in descending order by score.
      Parameters:
      playerCount - the match mode (number of players) to filter by
      limit - the maximum number of records to retrieve (e.g., 10 for Top 10)
      Returns:
      a sorted List of ScoreRecord objects ordered by descending score, or an empty list if no records are found

    • getPlayerRank

      public int getPlayerRank(int playerCount, String nickname, int points)
      Calculates the rank of this match of the player based on its score.
      Parameters:
      playerCount - The match mode (number of players).
      nickname - The player name.
      points - The score achieved by the player in this match.
      Returns:
      The 1-based rank position of the player. This method counts how many players have an equal or higher score in the same player count mode. This works because if there are two players with the same score, it takes the last one added, so the one just finished.
